dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: There's no class on Monday! What are your plans?
dialogue.reading: ðɛrz ˈnoʊ ˈklæs ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ! ˈwʌt ər jʊr ˈplænz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: On Saturday morning, I'm going to work.
dialogue.reading: ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈwɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm going to see my grandparents with my family.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈsiː maɪ ˈɡrænpɛrənts wɪð maɪ ˈfæməli.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nice! I'm going to go out with some friends on Monday. Come with us!
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs! aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈɡoʊ ˈaʊt wɪð sʌm ˈfrɛndz ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ. ˈkʌm wɪð ʌs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry. On Monday, I'm going to sleep in and relax at home.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri. ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈsliːp ˈɪn ənd rɪˈlæks ət ˈhoʊm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But we're going to see a movie and have dinner!
dialogue.reading: bʌt wɪr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈsiː ə ˈmuːvi ənd ˈhæv ˈdɪnər!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well… OK! I can sleep in and then go out with you!
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl… oʊˈkeɪ! aɪ kən ˈsliːp ˈɪn ənd ˈðɛn ˈɡoʊ ˈaʊt wɪð juː!
